bullets.text: Collector Kavitha announced that a special ration card grievance redressal camp will be held today across nine taluk supply offices in Thiruvallur district, and the office should monitor turnout.

Avadi City Police arrested two men from Keralam and seized 10 kg of ganja near Poonamallee after acting on a tip-off, and the office should track further updates on the drug trafficking investigation.

The Department of Industries, Investment Promotion and Commerce convened a roundtable with realty developers to fast-track the Tamil Nadu GCC Corridor, and the portfolio team should coordinate on corridor progress.
Bharathidasan Institute of Management partnered with the University of Texas at Arlington to launch an MS in AI in Business next year, and the ministry should note this educational expansion.
